findings.detail: The extracted Experigreen direct-lending revolver has a blank interest_rate from the commitment schedule, while the matching SOI investment row states 8.40%.
The commitment-schedule Experigreen revolver row is being surfaced as a rate-bearing direct-lending holding even though that schedule does not contain an Interest Rate column.

rationale: This aggregate rate-fill flag is grounded by a representative direct-lending blank from the bundle: Experigreen Intermediate Holdings, Inc. appears as a Revolver commitment with no interest_rate in the extracted holdings, but the raw SOI investment table lists the matching Experigreen First Lien Revolver with Reference Rate and Spread S + 4.75 % and Interest Rate 8.40 %. The blank is therefore not source ambiguity; the rate exists in source and was not carried into the extracted row, or the commitment-only row should be scoped out of the rate-fill population.
